test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

(Hardly had the news leak out that) my telephone started ringing.

options.text: No sooner did the news leaked out than
No sooner had the news leaked out than
No sooner had the news leaked out that

solution:
**Option 2** is the correct answer: "No sooner had the news leaked out than"

**Explanation:**

The original sentence uses the phrase "hardly had" to indicate that something happened immediately after something else. The correct phrase to replace it with is "no sooner had."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Option 1, "No sooner did the news leaked out than," is incorrect because it uses the wrong verb tense. "Leaked" is past tense, but "did" requires present tense.

Option 3, "No sooner had the news leaked out that," is also incorrect because it uses the wrong conjunction. "That" is not the correct conjunction to use after "leaked out" in this context.

Option 4, "No improvement," is incorrect because the original sentence needs to be improved to make grammatical sense.
